title: Table Mirrors the Chart
description: The bar charts and the data table below them are two views of the exact same buckets — if a bar shows one number and the table row for the same period shows another, someone's report is lying to them.
successCondition: For every period row rendered in the Reporting page's data table, the shipment volume chart's bar for that same period (matched by its label/period text) shows the identical shipmentCount value, and the revenue chart's bar for that period shows the identical revenueCents-derived dollar value — checked across every row, not just the first.
hints: Both charts' <title> elements inside each <rect> (visible on hover, or readable from the DOM) restate the exact label and formatted value for that bar — a convenient source to diff against the table row.
Pick a date range with at least 3-4 buckets so a single-row coincidental match doesn't give a false pass.
